statements.impact_statement: Not exposed: REEVALUATE (touched) — tour-controller.ts was edited by the prior security triage run (commit aa33aa8) which only added the inline `// nosemgrep:` marker on line 52 above the sink; the sink itself and its callee are unchanged. Re-verified against current code: at tour-controller.ts:53, `res.send(await TourService.save(req.user!.id, req.body))` sends the return of TourService.save (tour-service.ts:58-65), shaped `{ status: TourStatus, step: number, tutorialCourseId: string | null }`. TourService.parse (tour-service.ts:68-85) strict-validates `status` with `STATUSES.includes(status)` against the Prisma TourStatus enum and coerces `step` through `boundedInteger(step, { min: 0, max: TOUR_STEP_COUNT - 1 })`; `tutorialCourseId` is a server-computed id from `DefaultTutorialService.id()`. No `req.body` string reaches the response. Express `res.send` on an object serialises to JSON with Content-Type application/json, which browsers cannot render as HTML. Original disposition re-confirmed with a fresh 90-day window.
